FAIL_TO_PASS: tdz-common: preserve common TDZ violations
object-expression: Tree-shake known object prototype functions
class-fields: supports class fields
literals-from-return-expressions: tracks literal values across return expressions
optional-chaining-missing-properties: supports optional chaining for missing properties
export-internal-namespace-as: supports exporting and resolving internal namespaces as names
array-elements: tracks elements of arrays
side-effects-this: When a constructor is called with the new keyword, changing its this has no side effects
for-in-scopes: properly associate or shadow variables in and around for-in-loops
class-static-initialization-block: supports class static initialization blocks
system-export-declarations: Renders declarations where some variables are exported
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
ignore-property-access-side-effects: ignore side-effects when accessing properties if treeshake.propertyReadSideEffects is false
modify-class-prototype: tree-shakes prototype modifications of classes
deoptimize-superclass: does not deoptimize the entire superclass when reassigning a property
minimal-this-mutation: mutates "this" only if necessary on function calls
for-of-scopes: properly associate or shadow variables in and around for-of-loops
return-after-error: tree-shakes entities referenced in a return statement after an error
dynamic-resolvable-if-statements: allows using variables to resolve conditionals
known-globals: does not consider it a side-effect if a known global variable is accessed
